originals.citation: Li, X., Liang, P., & Li, Z. (2020). Automatic identification of decisions from the Hibernate developer mailing list. Proceedings of EASE 2020.

quote: In this paper, we present a replication study of our previous work (EASE2020), which conducted experiments to automatically identify decisions from the Hibernate developer mailing list.
notes: Self-replication. @li2019b is an exploratory study on decisions (not the classification experiment); @fu2020 is this paper's own replication package.
